items.title: HUD WARNING (ROUND 4)
items.where: block roused / doors released / door shut / pulse stopped at the door

takes.a: A military warning alarm on a control console: two short harsh low buzzer blasts, urgent and serious, dry, no reverb, no voices.
takes.b: A submarine style caution klaxon, one short low honk that cuts off abruptly, menacing, dry, no voices.
takes.c: A red alert warning tone from a security system: three fast sharp descending electronic beeps, tense and urgent, dry.
takes.d: A dark cinematic warning stinger: one short distorted low synth blast like an alarm horn, threatening, cuts off sharply, no melody.
takes.e: A harsh electronic error buzz from an old security terminal, a single rough rasping buzz of half a second, access denied, dry.
